nameOfQualification: Senior Production Associate- Ophthalmic Medical Devices Manufacturing- Consumables and Disposables
description: This program equips individuals with advanced skills essential for a Senior Production Associate role in the medical device manufacturing sector. Learners will gain expertise in production planning, efficient inventory management, proactive production support, and effective problem-solving. A strong focus is placed on supervising quality in compliance with GMP and relevant standards, driving process improvements, fostering teamwork, and ensuring a safe working environment. Upon completion, participants will be prepared to contribute significantly to the high-quality and efficient production of medical devices.
